## Required

Only trip and set IDs. The configuration ID and bite-off count are optional.

## Available

There are 209,430 branchline records, but no positive cut-off or hook-loss flags in the selected trips.

Those false defaults do not prove that observers recorded zero bite-offs.

## To decide

Ask Pascal which recorded event means a bite-off and whether the relevant branchlines were actually observed.

Do not calculate a count or assign a configuration until that is clear.

An ID-only row produces a warning. An empty sheet is structurally possible; the reporting rule remains open.
